traps: The active gcloud project is slotd-app. ALWAYS pass --project explicitly - and note that even with --project, an API-not-enabled check resolves against the QUOTA project, so errors can name slotd-app while you are targeting lawn-dart. Set CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT too.
lawn-dart has App Engine, so its project ID is permanently reserved and it cannot be fully deleted.

lawn-dart has 142 enabled APIs (up from 88 on 2026-05-05). Enabled-but-dormant billing-surprise vectors confirmed present: aiplatform, dialogflow, discoveryengine, retail, texttospeech, visionai, youtube, youtubeanalytics.
11 user-managed SA JSON keys (7 on lawn-dart, 4 on slotd-app), up from 9 on 2026-05-05. Prefer workload identity or short-lived tokens over minting another.
client-mx-campaign IS billing-enabled on the open account. A 2026-05-05 note calling it dormant was wrong.
Terraform has no ADC configured; authenticate with GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN from `gcloud auth print-access-token` (~1h lifetime).
gcloud tokens expire and cannot re-auth non-interactively. If a command fails on reauthentication, ask Joe to run `gcloud auth login`.

doesNotHave.note: The negative space kills more bad guesses than the positive list. Do not propose anything below without saying it needs to be set up first.
items: No BigQuery billing export - per-SKU cost queries are NOT available from the CLI.
No Security Command Center on either active project.

NO CLOUD SQL ANYWHERE. sqladmin.googleapis.com is not even enabled on lawn-dart or slotd-app (verified 2026-08-08). platform.json names Cloud SQL as the store for a relational system of record - that is a target, not a resource. Standing one up means enabling the API, creating an instance, and accepting an always-on bill. Treat it as a project, not a config line.
No HA failover on the homelab cluster - a node going down does not self-heal.
NetBox's REST API is broken (Invalid v1 token). Use the Django ORM over SSH.
The claude.ai MCP connector cannot reach n8n on naten (tailnet-only).
No CI has access to GCP secrets or the VM - GitHub Actions are validate-only by design.

placeholderEnvVars.note: SET, not absent. These hold literal placeholder strings, so a script reading one gets truthy garbage and fails far from the cause. Never read them expecting a real value.
placeholderEnvVars.exception: SUPABASE_URL is real and is a connection string - treat as a secret, never echo it.
